raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash VL routing uses the fused Triton router only on CUDA. On ROCm, prefill batches with images fall back to an eager softplus → topk → gather → renormalize chain. In a 16k-token VL prefill chunk on MI350X (TP4) that chain costs about 19 ms per chunk, mostly in `gatherTopK`. B200 spends about 1 ms on the fused router for the same chunk.

The Triton router has no CUDA-only code on ROCm: its only CUDA-specific feature is PDL, and PDL is already off on HIP. Text-only routing and decode are unchanged.

## Modifications

`python/sglang/srt/multimodal/dsv41/vl_routing.py`: take the fused path on ROCm too. No new flags or env vars.

```diff
-from sglang.srt.utils import is_cuda
+from sglang.srt.utils import is_cuda_alike
@@
-    if is_cuda():
+    if is_cuda_alike():
         from sglang.kernels.ops.moe.moe_fused_gate import moe_fused_gate
```

The existing CPU test that forces the eager path now patches the new name.

## Accuracy Tests

- New GPU test `test/registered/kernels/ops/moe/test_dsv41_vl_router.py`, registered for CUDA and AMD CI. It runs the fused and eager VL routing paths on the same mixed image/text batch (384 experts, top-6, with and without a fused shared expert, with padded rows) and checks that they select the same experts with the same weights, and that padded rows stay empty. Passes on MI355X (`rocm/sgl-dev:v0.5.21-rocm724-mi35x-20261012`, 8/8 subtests), and fails if the fused kernel is disabled, so it does exercise the fused path on ROCm. The edited CPU test passes too.
- Standalone check on MI350X at the DSv4.1 shape (384 experts, top-6, routed scaling 1.5), M from 1 to 16384: identical expert selection in 16/16 cases (one exact score tie), max weight difference 1.8e-7.
- MMMU on MI350X, TP4: 0.7539 with this change (2 runs), the same as without it (0.7539).

## Speed Tests and Profiling

MI350X, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, TP4, image benchmark (`sglang-oai-chat`, output 64 tokens), the same image with and without this change, median of 2 runs each:

| Image · input · concurrency | TTFT before (ms) | TTFT after (ms) | Δ | Output tok/s before | after | Δ |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 512x512 · 1024 · 16 | 246 | 242 | −2% | 345 | 371 | +7% |
| 768x1024 · 1024 · 16 | 320 | 285 | −11% | 536 | 611 | +14% |
| 2048x1600 · 1024 · 16 | 1244 | 999 | −20% | 365 | 389 | +7% |
| 768x1024 · 256 · 16 | 313 | 291 | −7% | 520 | 537 | +3% |
| 768x1024 · 8192 · 16 | 1527 | 1202 | −21% | 298 | 309 | +4% |
| 768x1024 · 1024 · 4 | 125 | 118 | −5% | 312 | 321 | +3% |
| 768x1024 · 1024 · 64 | 876 | 828 | −5% | 925 | 989 | +7% |
| 768x1024 · 1024 · 256 | 1212 | 1211 | 0% | 1111 | 1141 | +3% |

Router alone at M=16384: 0.713 → 0.052 ms per call. In a profiled 16k-token prefill chunk: 217.9 → 197.3 ms.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations). (not needed)
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

Related: #42189 also edits `vision_topk` (the TopK post-processing, not this platform check); the two should rebase cleanly on each other.

@@ -0,0 +1,99 @@
+"""DSv4.1 VL routing: the fused Triton router must match the eager fallback."""
+
+import unittest
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from unittest.mock import patch
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.srt.layers.moe.topk import TopKConfig
+from sglang.srt.multimodal.dsv41 import vl_routing
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_amd_ci, register_cuda_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+register_cuda_ci(est_time=10, stage="base-b-kernel-unit", runner_config="1-gpu-large")
+# backend-specific: ROCm takes the same fused path, compiled by the HIP Triton backend.
+register_amd_ci(est_time=10, stage="jit-kernel-unit", runner_config="amd")
+
+DEVICE = "cuda"
+NUM_EXPERTS = 384
+TOP_K = 6
+IMAGE_TOKEN_ID = 99
+
+
+def _moe(num_fused_shared, apply_scale_on_output):
+    gen = torch.Generator(device=DEVICE).manual_seed(0)
+    bias, bias_vl = (
+        (torch.randn(NUM_EXPERTS, generator=gen, device=DEVICE) * 0.1).bfloat16()
+        for _ in range(2)
+    )
+    return SimpleNamespace(
+        config=SimpleNamespace(image_token_id=IMAGE_TOKEN_ID),
+        gate=SimpleNamespace(
+            e_score_correction_bias=bias, e_score_correction_bias_vl=bias_vl
+        ),
+        topk=SimpleNamespace(
+            topk_config=TopKConfig(
+                top_k=TOP_K + num_fused_shared,
+                num_fused_shared_experts=num_fused_shared,
+                renormalize=True,
+                routed_scaling_factor=1.5,
+                apply_routed_scaling_factor_on_output=apply_scale_on_output,
+            )
+        ),
+        layer_id=0,
+    )
+
+
+def _dense(output, num_columns, num_valid):
+    """Scatter routing to [rows, experts] so slot order and tie order don't matter."""
+    ids = output.topk_ids[:num_valid].long()
+    dense = torch.zeros((num_valid, num_columns), device=DEVICE)
+    return dense.scatter_(1, ids, output.topk_weights[:num_valid].float())
+
+
+class TestDsv41VlRouter(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_fused_router_matches_eager(self):
+        """Image rows use the VL bias and padded rows stay empty on both paths."""
+        for num_tokens in (7, 1024):
+            for num_fused_shared in (0, 1):
+                for apply_scale_on_output in (False, True):
+                    with self.subTest(
+                        num_tokens=num_tokens,
+                        num_fused_shared=num_fused_shared,
+                        apply_scale_on_output=apply_scale_on_output,
+                    ):
+                        self._check(num_tokens, num_fused_shared, apply_scale_on_output)
+
+    def _check(self, num_tokens, num_fused_shared, apply_scale_on_output):
+        gen = torch.Generator(device=DEVICE).manual_seed(num_tokens)
+        moe = _moe(num_fused_shared, apply_scale_on_output)
+        logits = torch.randn(num_tokens, NUM_EXPERTS, generator=gen, device=DEVICE) * 2
+        is_image = torch.rand(num_tokens, generator=gen, device=DEVICE) < 0.7
+        input_ids = torch.where(is_image, IMAGE_TOKEN_ID, 1000)
+        num_valid = num_tokens - 3
+        num_token_non_padded = torch.tensor(num_valid, dtype=torch.int32, device=DEVICE)
+
+        def route():
+            return vl_routing.vision_topk(
+                moe, logits, input_ids, num_token_non_padded=num_token_non_padded
+            )
+
+        fused = route()
+        with patch.object(vl_routing, "is_cuda_alike", return_value=False):
+            eager = route()
+
+        num_columns = NUM_EXPERTS + num_fused_shared
+        torch.testing.assert_close(
+            _dense(fused, num_columns, num_valid),
+            _dense(eager, num_columns, num_valid),
+            atol=1e-5,
+            rtol=1e-5,
+        )
+        for output in (fused, eager):
+            self.assertTrue((output.topk_ids[num_valid:] == -1).all())
+            self.assertTrue((output.topk_weights[num_valid:] == 0).all())
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
